{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the data
print(df.head())
print('\nData info:\n', df.info())

# Calculate response rate for treatment and control groups
response_rate_treatment = df[df['treatment'] == 1]['response'].mean()
response_rate_control = df[df['treatment'] == 0]['response'].mean()

# Calculate treatment effect as difference in proportions
treatment_effect = response_rate_treatment - response_rate_control

(treatment_effect, response_rate_treatment, response_rate_control)"}
